name: ProjectWorldModel
objective: Create a compact canonical world model of DUMMIE that unifies plan state, layers, languages, specs, tests, artifacts, memory systems, known debt and next actions into a high-value context source.
why_now: P6 established canonical polyglot architecture. P7 must compile the project world model so future agents can load one compact, truthful view instead of reconstructing the repo from raw files or chat memory.
must_not_create: runtime-heavy ContextQuant implementation before ProjectWorldModel exists
success_conditions: world model references current_position and next_phase_seed
world model summarizes known capabilities and debt
world model is compact enough for future context loading
world model blocks Python-only global summaries
